core_obligations: Adjointness: chain the identifications $\mathrm{Mor}_{\QCoh}(f^*\mathcal{G}, \mathcal{F}) = \mathrm{Mor}_{\mathrm{LQCoh}^{fbc}}(\mathcal{G}, f_*\mathcal{F}) = \mathrm{Mor}_{\QCoh}(\mathcal{G}, Q(f_*\mathcal{F})) = \mathrm{Mor}_{\QCoh}(\mathcal{G}, f_{\QCoh, *}\mathcal{F})$, each step justified (adjunction for sheaves; LQCoh^{fbc} membership and topology-independence by the base-change proposition; $Q$-adjointness by lemma-adjoint; definition of $f_{\QCoh, *}$) (proof lines 2156-2173).

$\delta$-functor setup: a short exact sequence in $\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{X})$ is exact up to parasitic modules (cited lemma); split it into the four short exact sequences with $\mathcal{P}_i$ parasitic and $\mathcal{I}_j, \mathcal{Q}_j$ in LQCoh^{fbc} (proof lines 2175-2200).

Assemble the connecting map: apply $R^i f_*$ to the four sequences (all terms in LQCoh^{fbc}); the $R^i f_* \mathcal{P}_j$ are parasitic (pushforward-parasitic) hence vanish under $Q$ (adjoint-kernel-parasitic); since $Q$ is exact, the composite $Q(R^i f_* \mathcal{F}_3) \to Q(R^{i+1} f_* \mathcal{F}_1)$ through $\mathcal{I}_3, \mathcal{Q}_2, \mathcal{I}_2$ is the connecting map (proof lines 2200-2246).
proof_roadmap: Prove the adjunction by a Mor chase through the three factor functors.
Break the quasi-coherent exact sequence into genuinely exact pieces with parasitic error terms.
Kill the parasitic terms under $Q$ and read off the connecting morphism.
difficulty_reason: Two real derivations: the adjointness is a three-equality Mor chase through the $f_*$-adjunction, the LQCoh^{fbc} membership of $f_*\mathcal{F}$, and the $Q$-adjunction of lemma-adjoint; the $\delta$-functor structure is built by breaking a quasi-coherent short exact sequence into four short exact sequences with parasitic terms, applying $R^i f_*$, killing the parasitic higher direct images (pushforward-parasitic plus the $Q$-exactness), and defining the connecting map through the surviving isomorphisms.
